# Job Pulse

> Job Pulse is a done-for-you remote job application service. We find remote roles that fit your resume, pay and goals, send 10–20 real applications for you every weekday, and prep you for the interviews with mentorship and group sessions.

## What you get
- Real applications on real company job boards, every weekday, starting the next weekday after intake
- Remote roles of all kinds (not just sales); hybrid or in-person in your city if you ask
- Progress reports listing every company, role and link
- Mentorship, group interview prep and 24/7 support from the Job Pulse team while your plan is active
- Month to month, cancel anytime

## Plans
- Starter: $50/month, 10 applications a day (~200 a month)
- Pro: $100/month, 20 applications a day (~400 a month), priority on fresh postings

No one can guarantee a job; Job Pulse guarantees the work: your full plan count of applications every weekday.
